- 727bace2 (first builder): `standings.overturn_result` and `standings.award_game`, each two adjustments under one reason, taken off together (`pairedWith`); an award adds a game played to each; migration **0024_paired_adjustments.sql**; forms "Overturn a result" and "Award a game not played" on Admin → Standings and stats; the overturn's reason names the game ("Owls 41–63 Otters: …"); seed Badgers -1 W +1 L. b79584cc: its note.

P4 §1 says so.

Unit test beside the command; `games-area-test.mjs` saves 47–51 after one overtime and sees "Final, OT" (its keyboard walk tabs past the new choice). P7 §5.2 says so.
